run_seq_train_cli: run the sequential population training script with argparse CLI arguments for sender and receiver agents
launch_partial_training: launch partial training for a game module using an Adam optimizer and cosine annealing scheduler
build_game_and_train: build a game from common options and train it with a single sender and receiver pair
add_senders_incrementally: add new senders one by one to the game and retrain the population incrementally
add_receivers_incrementally: add new receivers one by one to the game and retrain the population incrementally
